= BITwiki vs BITHUB Boundary Specification =

== Executive Summary ==

This document establishes the formal boundary specification between '''BITwiki''' (the semantic knowledge management system) and '''BITHUB''' (the agent orchestration infrastructure). It defines agent responsibilities, interaction protocols, data flow boundaries, and escalation procedures to ensure clear separation of concerns while enabling seamless collaboration.

'''Document ID''': HIGH-001  
'''Priority''': HIGH  
'''Status''': Active Specification  
'''Version''': 1.0.0  
'''Last Updated''': 2026-02-13

----
== 1. System Architecture Overview ==

=== 1.1 BITwiki System Domain ===

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph BITwiki["BITwiki Knowledge System"]
        SMW[Semantic MediaWiki]
        EPV[EPV Framework]
        Templates[Template System]
        Ontology[Ontology Layer]
        Query[SMW Query Engine]
    end
    
    BITwiki -->|Knowledge Graph| Storage[(Semantic Data Store)]
    BITwiki -->|Rendered Pages| Web[Web Interface]
```

'''Core Responsibilities''':
* Knowledge representation and semantic annotation
* Epistemic provenance tracking (EPV framework)
* Template-based document generation
* Ontology management and validation
* Queryable knowledge graph maintenance

=== 1.2 BITHUB System Domain ===

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph BITHUB["BITHUB Agent Infrastructure"]
        Orchestrator[Agent Orchestrator]
        Scheduler[Task Scheduler]
        A2A[A2A Protocol Layer]
        Memory[Memory System]
        Subordinates[Subordinate Agents]
    end
    
    BITHUB -->|Task Results| BITwiki
    BITHUB -->|Agent Coordination| External[External Services]
```

'''Core Responsibilities''':
* Agent lifecycle management
* Task scheduling and execution
* Inter-agent communication (A2A protocol)
* Memory persistence and retrieval
* Subordinate agent orchestration

----
== 2. Agent Boundary Definitions ==

=== 2.1 BITwiki Agent Responsibilities ===

| Capability | In Scope | Out of Scope |
|------------|----------|--------------|
| '''Document Creation''' | Wiki pages, templates, SMW markup | Raw binary files, external databases |
| '''Knowledge Modeling''' | Ontology design, property schemas | ML model training, statistical inference |
| '''Validation''' | SMW syntax, YAML frontmatter, epistemic consistency | Runtime performance, security auditing |
| '''Query Design''' | SMW #ask queries, concept relationships | SQL optimization, distributed query execution |
| '''Template Development''' | MediaWiki templates, Lua modules | Frontend JavaScript, CSS frameworks |

=== 2.2 BITHUB Agent Responsibilities ===

| Capability | In Scope | Out of Scope |
|------------|----------|--------------|
| '''Task Orchestration''' | Scheduling, delegation, monitoring | Business logic implementation |
| '''Agent Communication''' | A2A protocol, message routing | Semantic interpretation of content |
| '''Memory Management''' | Persistence, retrieval, forgetting | Epistemic validation of memories |
| '''Tool Integration''' | Browser, search, code execution | Domain-specific tool development |
| '''Workflow Automation''' | n8n integration, HTTP requests | Wiki page automation |

=== 2.3 Shared Responsibilities ===

```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph Shared["Shared Domain"]
        Research[Research Synthesis]
        Validation[Quality Validation]
        Documentation[Documentation Generation]
    end
    
    BITwiki -->|Content Standards| Shared
    BITHUB -->|Process Standards| Shared
```

'''Collaborative Zones''':
* Research synthesis and documentation
* Quality validation and verification
* File system operations within project scope
* YAML frontmatter processing

----
== 3. Data Flow Boundaries ==

=== 3.1 BITwiki → BITHUB Data Flow ===

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant BW as BITwiki
    participant FS as File System
    participant BH as BITHUB
    
    BW->>FS: Write specification document
    BW->>FS: Create template files
    BW->>FS: Update ontology definitions
    FS->>BH: Read for task execution
    BH->>BH: Parse YAML frontmatter
    BH->>BH: Extract SMW properties
    BH->>FS: Write execution results
```

'''Permitted Data Types''':
* Markdown files with YAML frontmatter
* MediaWiki markup files (.wiki)
* JSON configuration files
* SMW query definitions
* Ontology specifications

=== 3.2 BITHUB → BITwiki Data Flow ===

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant BH as BITHUB
    participant FS as File System
    participant BW as BITwiki
    
    BH->>FS: Write research output
    BH->>FS: Create validation reports
    BH->>FS: Generate template improvements
    FS->>BW: Read for integration
    BW->>BW: Validate SMW syntax
    BW->>BW: Check epistemic consistency
    BW->>FS: Update knowledge base
```

'''Permitted Data Types''':
* Research synthesis documents
* Validation reports with epistemic metadata
* Improved template specifications
* Lua module definitions
* Configuration updates

=== 3.3 Forbidden Crossings ===

| From | To | Forbidden Action | Reason |
|------|----|------------------|--------|
| BITHUB | BITwiki | Direct database writes | Bypass validation layer |
| BITwiki | BITHUB | Agent spawning | Orchestration is BITHUB domain |
| BITHUB | External | Unauthenticated API calls | Security boundary |
| BITwiki | External | Raw HTTP requests | Protocol violation |

----
== 4. Interaction Protocols ==

=== 4.1 Task Delegation Protocol ===

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant BITHUB
    participant BITwiki
    
    User->>BITHUB: Submit complex task
    BITHUB->>BITHUB: Analyze task scope
    alt BITwiki Domain Task
        BITHUB->>BITwiki: Delegate via call_subordinate
        BITwiki->>BITwiki: Execute knowledge task
        BITwiki->>BITHUB: Return results
    else BITHUB Domain Task
        BITHUB->>BITHUB: Execute directly
    end
    BITHUB->>User: Present final results
```

'''Delegation Rules''':
# BITHUB analyzes task and determines domain
# Knowledge-heavy tasks → BITwiki subordinate
# Infrastructure tasks → BITHUB execution
# Mixed tasks → Coordinated execution

=== 4.2 File System Protocol ===

'''BITwiki File Operations''':
* Read/Write: `/a0/usr/projects/*/book-matter/`
* Read/Write: `/a0/usr/projects/*/research/`
* Read: `/a0/usr/projects/*/docs/`

'''BITHUB File Operations''':
* Read/Write: `/a0/usr/projects/*/`
* Read/Write: `/a0/tmp/`
* Execute: System commands, package installation

=== 4.3 Memory Protocol ===

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph BITwiki_Memory["BITwiki Memory Domain"]
        KM[Knowledge Memories]
        OM[Ontology Memories]
        TM[Template Memories]
    end
    
    subgraph BITHUB_Memory["BITHUB Memory Domain"]
        PM[Process Memories]
        CM[Configuration Memories]
        UM[User Preferences]
    end
    
    BITwiki_Memory -.->|Read-Only| BITHUB_Memory
    BITHUB_Memory -.->|Write-Only| BITwiki_Memory
```

'''Memory Access Rules''':
* BITwiki: Owns knowledge, ontology, template memories
* BITHUB: Owns process, configuration, user memories
* Cross-read permitted, cross-write requires validation

----
== 5. Escalation Procedures ==

=== 5.1 Escalation Triggers ===

| Trigger | From | To | Condition |
|---------|------|----|-----------|
| Validation Failure | BITwiki | BITHUB | SMW syntax errors exceed threshold |
| Scope Ambiguity | BITHUB | User | Task spans both domains |
| Resource Exhaustion | Either | User | Time/memory limits exceeded |
| Security Concern | Either | User | Potential data breach |

=== 5.2 Escalation Workflow ===

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Task Execution] --> B{Success?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Return Results]
    B -->|No| D{Domain Issue?}
    D -->|BITwiki| E[BITwiki Recovery]
    D -->|BITHUB| F[BITHUB Recovery]
    D -->|Both| G[Escalate to User]
    E --> H{Resolved?}
    F --> H
    H -->|Yes| C
    H -->|No| G
```

----
== 6. Compliance Verification ==

=== 6.1 Boundary Compliance Checklist ===
* [ ] All SMW markup in `` blocks
* [ ] No direct database writes from BITHUB
* [ ] YAML frontmatter on all BITwiki documents
* [ ] Proper agent profile selection for tasks
* [ ] File operations within designated paths
* [ ] Memory access following read/write rules

=== 6.2 Validation Query ===

```smw
{{#ask:[[Category:Governance Documents]]
 [[Has document type::Boundary Specification]]
 |?Has epistemic status
 |?Has confidence level
 |?Has verification state
 |format=table
}}
```

----
== 7. References ==

# BITwiki Technical Standards Framework v1.0
# BITHUB Agent Orchestration Specification
# A2A Protocol Specification v0.2
# EPV Framework Documentation
# SMW Best Practices Guide
# Agent Zero System Manual
# n8n Workflow Documentation
# MediaWiki Architecture Manual

----
== Appendix A: Agent Capability Matrix ==

| Capability | BITwiki | BITHUB | Shared |
|------------|---------|--------|--------|
| Wiki Markup | ✓ | Read | - |
| SMW Queries | ✓ | Read | - |
| Template Design | ✓ | - | - |
| Lua Modules | ✓ | - | - |
| Task Scheduling | - | ✓ | - |
| Agent Spawning | - | ✓ | - |
| Memory Management | Read | ✓ | Write |
| File Operations | Project | Full | - |
| Web Search | - | ✓ | - |
| Code Execution | - | ✓ | - |

----
''Document generated by Agent Zero Developer''  
''BITwiki Governance Framework v1.0''  
''Specification ID: HIGH-001''

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph BITwiki_Memory["BITwiki Memory Domain"]
        KM[Knowledge Memories]
        OM[Ontology Memories]
        TM[Template Memories]
    end
    
    subgraph BITHUB_Memory["BITHUB Memory Domain"]
        PM[Process Memories]
        CM[Configuration Memories]
        UM[User Preferences]
    end
    
    BITwiki_Memory -.->|Read-Only| BITHUB_Memory
    BITHUB_Memory -.->|Write-Only| BITwiki_Memory
```

'''Memory Access Rules''':
* BITwiki: Owns knowledge, ontology, template memories
* BITHUB: Owns process, configuration, user memories
* Cross-read permitted, cross-write requires validation

== 5. Escalation Procedures ==

=== 5.1 Escalation Triggers ===

| Trigger | From | To | Condition |
|---------|------|----|-----------|
| Validation Failure | BITwiki | BITHUB | SMW syntax errors exceed threshold |
| Scope Ambiguity | BITHUB | User | Task spans both domains |
| Resource Exhaustion | Either | User | Time/memory limits exceeded |
| Security Concern | Either | User | Potential data breach |

=== 5.2 Escalation Workflow ===

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Task Execution] --> B{Success?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Return Results]
    B -->|No| D{Domain Issue?}
    D -->|BITwiki| E[BITwiki Recovery]
    D -->|BITHUB| F[BITHUB Recovery]
    D -->|Both| G[Escalate to User]
    E --> H{Resolved?}
    F --> H
    H -->|Yes| C
    H -->|No| G
```
